question: Can any situation be entirely free from auspicious and inauspicious experience?
premises: Auspicious and inauspicious outcomes must be experienced
No place or condition is stated as exempt
Absence of such experience is denied
inference: Auspicious and inauspicious experience pervades all situations without exception
plain_english: Auspicious and inauspicious things must be experienced, and nowhere is one ever devoid of them.
